disposition_reason: Arsenic, cadmium, lead, chromium, nickel and cobalt were measured by ICP-OES in 40 bread samples (Barbari, Sangak, Lavash, baguette) from Rasht bakeries; per-type means are stated in the text but abstract and discussion values conflict.

study.design: Survey of 40 bread samples of four types from 124 bakeries
study.origin: baked in bakeries in Rasht City, Guilan province, Iran
study.market: bakeries in different areas of Rasht City
study.method: Air-dried, ground with titanium knives; HNO3/HClO4 hot-plate digestion; ICP-OES (Spectro Arcos)
study.lod_text: Instrument detection limits (ppb): As 1.19, Pb 2.1, Cd 0.05, Cr 0.1, Co 0.05, Ni 0.3
study.qa: Duplicate analyses; no CRM, recovery or blanks reported

unresolved: Abstract means for Cd and Pb (Barbari 0.73/0.07, Sangak 0.13/0.64, Lavash 0.2/0.3, Baguette 0.09/0.9 mg/kg) conflict with the Discussion means (Cd 0.13/0.07/0.02/0.09; Pb 0.64/0.73/0.33/0.9); Discussion values are recorded with integrity flags.
Results section 4.1 lists six ranges per bread for five metals, so ranges cannot be assigned to metals; they are not recorded.
Table 2 daily intakes imply Barbari Pb about 0.73 mg/kg, supporting the abstract ordering; not used (no back-calculation).
Figure 1 axis scales (Pb to 8, Cr to 35 mg/kg) do not match the stated means; values figure-only.
Number of samples per bread type is not stated.
No DOI is printed in the PDF; the manifest DOI is used.
